main.description: Declares membership in a forum. Lives in the member's own repo, pointing at the forum's DID — joining is an act of the member, leaving is deleting this record.

wearing.description: Stamp ids the member wears on this forum, in order: an admin stamp's at-uri, or the fixed id of a generated stamp (atmobb:board:<board at-uri>, atmobb:arrival, atmobb:first-light, atmobb:early-days).

pinned.description: At-uris of the member's own topics on this forum, pinned to their profile page in order.
